headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 2, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays took down the St. Louis Cardinals 5-1, with Kevin Gausman earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. The Seattle Mariners secured a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Andrés Muñoz earning the win. Randy Arozarena led the Twins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups and rotations. The Los Angeles Dodgers placed right-handed pitcher Will Klein on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort. The San Francisco Giants placed catcher Jesus Rodriguez on the 10-day injured list with right elbow neuritis. The Seattle Mariners also placed right fielder Luke Raley on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 31, 2026, due to a left forearm strain.

The Atlanta Braves bolstered their outfield with the acquisition of center fielder Lane Thomas from the Kansas City Royals. Thomas joins the Braves in exchange for left-hander Carter Holton and right-hander Lucas Braun. The Seattle Mariners traded right-hander Luis Castillo to the Chicago White Sox for right-hander Seranthony Domínguez, catcher Boston Smith, right fielder Nolan Jones, and cash.

top_news.title: **Mariners Edge Twins in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Andrés Muñoz earning the win. Randy Arozarena led the Twins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down White Sox 1-0**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a narrow victory over the Chicago White Sox, winning 1-0. Drew Rasmussen led the Rays' pitching effort, throwing 6.0 innings with 10 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Mets 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 6-2 victory over the New York Mets, with Javier Sanoja leading the offense. Sanoja hit 2 home runs, drove in 2 runs, and had 5 at-bats in the win.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Place Will Klein on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Will Klein has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort. The move was made on August 1, 2026.

top_news.title: **Braves Bolster Outfield with Lane Thomas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves have acquired center fielder Lane Thomas from the Kansas City Royals in a trade. Thomas joins the Braves after being dealt along with left-hander Bailey Falter in exchange for left-hander Carter Holton and right-hander Lucas Braun.
